# Code-First Agents

> Design patterns for building reliable AI agents by moving deterministic work from the LLM to code. The LLM orchestrates. Code executes.

The site documents two patterns (Deterministic Tools, Skill Orchestration) and a spectrum of three levels (Data, Classification, Instructions) showing how much decision-making to absorb from the LLM into deterministic code.

## Pages

- [Home](https://code-first-agents.com/index.md): The thesis, the architecture, the spectrum, and when to go code-first
- [Deterministic Tools](https://code-first-agents.com/patterns/deterministic-tools.md): How to build CLI tools that do deterministic work and output JSON. The tool contract, the output spectrum, and progressive examples.
- [Skill Orchestration](https://code-first-agents.com/patterns/skill-orchestration.md): How to write SKILL.md files that consume tool output. The LLM as executor, chaining tools, guards, and the verbatim execution principle.

## Code

The example tools and skill referenced on the site live in the [`main` branch](https://github.com/beogip/code-first-agents/tree/main/examples) of the repository.

- [get-issue-signals.ts](https://github.com/beogip/code-first-agents/blob/main/examples/tools/get-issue-signals.ts): Level 1 (Data) — fetches a GitHub issue and returns raw signals
- [classify-issue.ts](https://github.com/beogip/code-first-agents/blob/main/examples/tools/classify-issue.ts): Level 2 (Classification) — scores signals and returns a complexity classification
- [analyze-issue.ts](https://github.com/beogip/code-first-agents/blob/main/examples/tools/analyze-issue.ts): Level 3 (Instructions) — returns a literal procedure for the LLM to execute verbatim
- [plan-issue/SKILL.md](https://github.com/beogip/code-first-agents/blob/main/examples/skills/plan-issue/SKILL.md): Example skill that consumes analyze-issue.ts at Level 3
